name: congenital myasthenic syndromes with glycosylation defect
description: Congenital myasthenic syndrome with glycosylation defect is a group of genetic disorders of impaired neuromuscular transmission at the motor endplate characterized by fatigable muscle weakness with a defect in glycosylation.
